title: Fold and Cut
summary: Layers multiply: count the layers before cutting.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Fold a square paper in half, then in half again, and cut a small triangle from the folded corner.
How many holes appear when you unfold it?
points: Fold a square paper in half, then in half again, and cut a small triangle from the folded corner.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The cut goes through all the layers at once.

steps.title: The method: Count the layers
sentences: Two folds make 4 layers of paper.
One cut through 4 layers makes 4 holes.
Where the fold lines cross you should be careful which corner you cut.
points: Two folds make 4 layers of paper.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: If the cut is in the free corner away from the folds, you get 4 holes, one in each quarter.
If you cut at the centre corner, the four holes join into one big hole.
Position matters as well as the count.
points: If the cut is in the free corner away from the folds, you get 4 holes, one in each quarter.

quiz.q: A paper is folded in half 3 times and one hole is punched. How many holes?
